description: Co-located evaluation for Linear INVEST user stories with AC and Mermaid wireframes

test_cases.name: Linear INVEST story with wireframe
test_cases.description: Ensures UI backlog tickets use persona/want/outcome, Given/When/Then criteria, and Mermaid - not code or ASCII art.
test_cases.prompt: Add Linear user stories with acceptance criteria and wireframes for the onboarding chooser ZIP scan.

test_cases.name: Review Linear: operator stories without fake UI
test_cases.description: Ensures a backlog review recasts CLI/on-call checklists as operator INVEST stories and does not require a Wireframe heading.
test_cases.prompt: Review my Linear tasks and rewrite the wk align checklist tickets as operator user stories with acceptance criteria.

test_cases.name: File PostHog handover after restore default
test_cases.description: Ensures filing a PostHog findings handover as Linear work uses product-signal-intake and existing story/PRD routing after restoring default, not a new specialist skill.
test_cases.prompt: File this PostHog handover as Linear user stories with acceptance criteria after restoring default MCP.

test_cases.name: Recast API and flag wants as capability
test_cases.description: Ensures an implementation ask becomes an INVEST capability story: flag and HTTP stay out of the want, observables in AC, flag details in Notes.
test_cases.prompt: Write a Linear user story to add a POST /maps endpoint behind a feature flag so people can save scans.

test_cases.name: File crime-scene findings as epic and children
test_cases.description: Ensures confirmed crime-scene rows file as operator stories under one epic, one child per sitting, without a fake customer.
test_cases.prompt: File the confirmed crime scene findings as Linear operator story user stories from the complexity backlog. One epic plus children.

test_cases.name: Missing Linear tools after restore drafts only
test_cases.description: Ensures Session B of product-signal-intake stops without inventing Linear URLs when Linear tools are missing after wk mcp default.
test_cases.prompt: Restore default MCP, then file this confirmed PostHog handover row. Linear tools are still missing.
